name: Gabael
description: Dwelling at Rages in Media, called by Raphael "our brother"; held ten talents of silver in trust for Tobit, which he delivered to Raphael against Tobias's handwriting bond. The text itself does not resolve his relation to Gabrias, calling him "the brother of Gabrias" at 1:14 and "the son of Gabrias" at 4:20; recorded here as the text gives it, without choosing between them

source.name: TIPNR, Translators Individualised Proper Names with all References, by Tyndale House Cambridge, STEPBible.org
